x.description: array_like Input array having shape (..., M, N) and whose two innermost dimensions form ``MxN`` matrices.
constraints: MxN matrices are formed by the two innermost dimensions of x.
x's size includes a variable number of leading dimensions represented by '...'.

output.description: ------- ndarray An array containing the transpose for each matrix and having shape (..., N, M).

constraints: The result has the transpose for each matrix along its last two dimensions.
